summary: Fusion Fuel Green PLC filed a 6-K disclosing a September 23, 2026 Share Exchange Agreement with majority-owned subsidiary Quality Industrial Corp. The Irish company will issue 500,000 Class A ordinary shares, valued at $2,000,000 at $4.00 per share, to three third-party investors: Sanjeeb Safir (40%), Safir Ahammed (40%) and Mohamed Hilal Saeed Muroushad Almheiri (20%). QIND simultaneously issues $2,000,000 of its common stock to Fusion Fuel as consideration, priced off recent closing prices. Shares are restricted, sold privately under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D/S. Watch the December 31, 2026 backstop converting to cash, plus dilution and QIND minority-holder overhang.
